surface: Command-line program: hello.sh prints one line to stdout. No UI, server, or TUI.
run: ./hello.sh from the repo root; POSIX sh, no dependencies, no build, no ports or env vars. Prints HELLO-FAMILY-13 and exits 0.
drive: Invoke ./hello.sh directly in a subshell and capture stdout, stderr and exit code. No PTY needed since it takes no input.
observe: stdout text (exactly HELLO-FAMILY-13 plus newline), empty stderr, exit code 0. No files, network or logs are produced.
isolate: Stateless and read-only, so any number of instances can run side by side; nothing shared to corrupt.
